_comment: Migrated from the former comfyui_known_nodes.json. Reference metadata for the VDN-H3 custom nodes (schema, install info, and GENie tokenize hints). No `recognize` block yet — these are documented for the tokenized Minimax H3 default workflow; add a recognize block to drive them from a raw drop-in.

ApplyVDNH3.description: VDN-H3: hybrid attention for MiniMax-H3. Nearby frames keep exact softmax attention; distant context goes through the checkpoint's linear Video Delta Attention branch. Applied as a MODEL patch between the diffusion-model loader and the sampler.

requires.base_model: A MiniMax-H3 diffusion model (blocks[].attn.qkv_proj); connect a MiniMax-H3 UNETLoader upstream.
requires.assets: A VDN stage directory under ComfyUI/models/vdn (from OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3), holding the linear-branch weights + spec. Must match the loaded base (stage-dmd-* = 8-step distilled).

model.tooltip: The MiniMax-H3 diffusion model to patch. Chain once, between the model loader and the sampler.

vdn_checkpoint.tooltip: The VDN stage directory holding the linear-branch weights and spec. Must match the loaded base.

apply_turbo_adapter.tooltip: Apply the 'turbo' adapter when the checkpoint carries one (stage-dmd = 8-step model). OFF gives the 50-step model it was distilled from. Use 8 sampler steps with it ON, 50 with it OFF.

strength.tooltip: Adapter strength. 1.0 is the released model.

lora_mode.tooltip: merge: adapters folded into the weights, reproducing the validated model exactly. REQUIRED for 8-step DMD checkpoints (stage-dmd-*).

branch_weights.tooltip: auto: cache_gpu when free VRAM after the base load exceeds 1.5x stage size + 4 GiB headroom, else stream. stream: ~4.3 GB of branch weights moved to GPU per block per step (safe on small cards). cache_gpu: resident on GPU (faster; keep ~4.3 GB free).

retain_buffers.tooltip: Retained branch scratch/banks trade ~0.5-1 GiB VRAM for churn-free steps. auto: retain when free VRAM >= stage + 10 GiB headroom, else transient.

verbose.tooltip: Log the applied adapters and the per-forward layout to the console.

attention_backend.tooltip: How the windowed softmax runs. grouped: one dense SDPA per window group (portable, exact). flex: the whole pattern as one compiled FlexAttention kernel (faster on long clips; falls back to grouped if compile fails).

genie.slot: MODEL patch between the diffusion-model loader and the sampler; place after the model, before any LoRAs.

tokenize.note: Only object_info-COMBO inputs group under a bypassable node's enable/disable toggle in GENie's ComfyUI Settings drawer (a token needs combo:true, which inline |a|b options do NOT set — so expose combos WITHOUT inline options and let /object_info populate them). Numbers and BOOLEANs are not combos, so bake them at defaults or accept that they render in the main form.

ApplyVDNH3Advanced.description: Everything ApplyVDNH3 does, plus per-adapter strengths (Stage-B and turbo), ablation knobs that deviate from the released spec (window radius/chunk, anchor frames, text state, linear branch), and compile-fused branch kernels (fast_kernels). Defaults reproduce the released model exactly.

requires.base_model: A MiniMax-H3 diffusion model (blocks[].attn.qkv_proj); connect a MiniMax-H3 UNETLoader upstream.
requires.assets: A VDN stage directory under ComfyUI/models/vdn (from OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3). Must match the loaded base.

model.tooltip: The MiniMax-H3 diffusion model to patch. Chain once, between the model loader and the sampler.

vdn_checkpoint.tooltip: The VDN stage directory holding the linear-branch weights and spec. Must match the loaded base.

apply_turbo_adapter.tooltip: Apply the 'turbo' adapter when the checkpoint carries one (8-step model).

branch_weights.tooltip: auto/stream/cache_gpu VRAM policy for the linear-branch weights; see ApplyVDNH3.

verbose.tooltip: Log the applied adapters and the per-forward layout to the console.

attention_backend.tooltip: How the windowed softmax runs; see ApplyVDNH3.

window_radius.tooltip: Softmax window radius in chunks. Trained: 1.

window_chunk.tooltip: Chunk size for the aligned window; 0 = per-frame centered window. Trained: 5.

text_state.tooltip: Write the prompt into the linear branch's states at init. Trained: on.

linear_branch.tooltip: Off = window-only ablation (debug; then lacks all long-range context on clips longer than the window).

fast_kernels.tooltip: torch.compile the branch's hot spots. Same math; falls back to eager if compile fails. Known to drift on 8-step DMD stages (stage-dmd-*) on torch 2.10 -- ablation use only, keep off for final renders.

genie.slot: MODEL patch between the diffusion-model loader and the sampler; place after the model, before any LoRAs.

tokenize.note: Only object_info-COMBO inputs group under a bypassable node's enable/disable toggle in GENie's ComfyUI Settings drawer (inline |a|b options do NOT set combo:true). Expose the combos without inline options; bake numbers/BOOLEANs at their trained defaults so the released model is reproduced.
